title: Site traffic
description: Visits to the public site. The only dashboard here with data behind it today: registrations and tour bookings are both empty, so an enrolment or booking dashboard would draw a flat line at zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*)::int AS "views" FROM page_analytics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS "Views" FROM page_analytics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Distinct visitors
panels.description: Counted from visitor_id, which became stable across days on 2026-08-17. Figures spanning earlier dates undercount returning visitors, because before that change the same browser produced a new id each day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id)::int AS "Visitors" FROM page_analytics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT page_path AS "Page", COUNT(*)::int AS "Views" FROM page_analytics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT COALESCE(device_type, 'unknown') AS "Device", COUNT(*)::int AS "Views" FROM page_analytics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT action AS "Action", COUNT(*)::int AS "Count" FROM admin_activity_log WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

options.content:
**Enrolment trends**, **booking status** and **class capacity** were asked for and are not here, because there is nothing to plot.

- `registrations` is empty, so an enrolment line would be flat at zero.
- `tour_bookings` is empty, so a status pie would have no slices.
- `age_groups` has no capacity column, so "how full is each room" has no denominator anywhere in the schema.

The alerts were left out for the same reason: **"bookings below 5 per day"** against zero bookings fires every day, forever. An alert that always fires teaches people to ignore alerts.

Add a capacity per room and take the first real bookings, and these become worth building — the queries are a few lines each.
